description: Browse, retrieve, and read CRS (Congressional Research Service) reports — nonpartisan policy analyses by subject-matter experts at the Library of Congress, covering policy areas, legislative proposals, and legal questions. Report IDs are letters then digits (R40097, RL33612, IF12345) or, for older reports, two digit groups joined by a hyphen (96-548). Use 'list' to browse available reports, newest update first, 'get' for full detail (authors, topics, summary, download formats, and related materials, which limit and offset page: relatedMaterialsCount and relatedMaterialsNextOffset appear when a page leaves rows out), or 'content' to read the report itself — its HTML version as plain text, a bounded character window at a time; feed nextOffset back as characterOffset to read on. The oldest reports publish only a PDF, which 'content' cannot read; the error names its URL. 'list' takes fromDateTime/toDateTime, which filter on the date Congress.gov last updated a report — not its publication date — so a window finds reports added or revised in it.

characterLimit.description: Maximum characters to return for 'content' (1-100000). Legislative documents run past a million characters, so a full bill takes several windows.

characterOffset.description: First character to return for 'content', 0-based. Offsets are exact and are never snapped to a section or paragraph break, so feeding the response's nextOffset back walks the whole document with every character returned exactly once.

fromDateTime.description: Start of the update-date window for 'list' (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z): the date Congress.gov last updated a report, not its publication date. Ignored by other operations.

limit.description: Results per page (1-250): reports on 'list', related materials on 'get'.

offset.description: Pagination offset: into the report list on 'list', into the report's related materials on 'get'.

reportNumber.description: CRS report ID — letters then digits (e.g. 'R40097', 'IF12345') or two digit groups joined by a hyphen (e.g. '96-548'). Case and surrounding whitespace are ignored. Required for 'get' and 'content'.

toDateTime.description: End of the update-date window for 'list' (ISO 8601). Same field semantics as fromDateTime. Ignored by other operations.

name: congressgov_crs_reports

data.description: Result rows. Per-tool item shape is rendered in the markdown body.

items.description: Upstream JSON record. Per-tool item shape is rendered in the markdown body.

effectiveQuery.description: The browse scope and applied filters.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: A requested bill, member, committee, report, vote, or nomination does not exist in Congress.gov. `rate_limited`: A process-local attempt budget or the shared upstream credential/IP quota was reached; upstream hourly limits vary and DEMO_KEY also has a daily quota. On a Senate vote the LIS feed could not answer, Voteview answering HTTP 429 is reported the same way. `invalid_request`: Congress.gov rejected the request as malformed — a bad date range or an identifier with an unexpected shape. `api_key_rejected`: The api.data.gov gateway rejected the server's configured CONGRESS_API_KEY (missing, invalid, disabled, unauthorized, or unverified); the gateway code is in data.upstreamCode. No change to the call's arguments can fix it. `upstream_error`: Congress.gov returned an unexpected error (5xx or another non-2xx status) or could not be reached, or a Senate vote could be read from neither the Senate LIS feed nor its Voteview fallback (before the 101st Congress there is no fallback, and there a senate.gov HTTP 403 refusal carries retryable: false). `upstream_timeout`: A Congress.gov request or a congress.gov document fetch timed out or returned an HTTP timeout response, or the call's upstream requests could not finish inside its 50-second budget. `document_unavailable`: The 'content' selection resolves to no retrievable document — the text version or article index is past the end of the list, the record publishes no formats at all, or Congress.gov does not hold the file its own metadata names. `format_unavailable`: The document exists but publishes nothing in a format this server reads — some text versions and committee reports ship PDF only, no Congressional Record article publishes XML, and the oldest CRS reports publish a PDF but no HTML. `document_fetch_failed`: www.congress.gov did not return a readable document — a non-2xx status, a network failure, an empty body, or a content type that is not text or XML. `document_too_large`: The document is larger than the byte ceiling this server retrieves, so no character window can be served from it. `offset_past_end`: characterOffset is at or beyond the last character of every text the call would window — the document on 'content', or every returned row's summary text on 'summaries' — so the window would be empty. `incompatible_identity`: A list operation carries an entity identifier that only a detail operation uses. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when results are empty, a page is past the end, or a caveat applies.

pagination.description: Pagination metadata: total count and next offset.

count.description: Total result count across all pages.

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass for the next page, or null when there are no more pages.

report.description: CRS report record for `get`: authors, topics, summary, formats, and one page of related materials.

relatedMaterialsCount.description: Total related materials the report lists. Present when 'get' returns part of the list: the list runs past limit, or offset is past 0.

relatedMaterialsNextOffset.description: The offset that returns the next page of related materials, or null on the last page. Present with relatedMaterialsCount.

title: Congress.gov CRS Reports
